findings.description: SecureString.withSecureAccess uses fatalError for invalid UTF-8. Consider throwing instead for production resilience.
findings.remediation: Replace fatalError with a throwing pattern or return Optional to prevent crashes from malformed data.

findings.description: SecureString.reveal() uses fatalError for invalid UTF-8. Same concern as withSecureAccess.
findings.remediation: Return Optional<String> instead of fatalError, allowing graceful degradation.

findings.description: URLComponents construction uses force unwrap (!). While the URL is hardcoded, this pattern should be avoided for consistency.
findings.remediation: Use guard let or try pattern for URLComponents construction, consistent with SecureURLConstruction pattern.

findings.description: URLComponents with interpolated path uses force unwrap. ID injection possible if ID contains special characters.
findings.remediation: Use URLComponents with proper path component encoding, following SecureURLConstruction pattern.

findings.description: SyncDouble.value nonisolated getter reads _value without synchronization. Value may be stale.
findings.remediation: Document that value is intentionally stale for diagnostics, or use atomic/actor pattern for real-time reads.

findings.description: FluidVadManager.processStreamingChunk returns stub VadResult. Real implementation pending.
findings.remediation: Document TODO for actual VAD logic integration. Current stub may cause transcription failures.

findings.description: Nonisolated(unsafe) used for converter callback. Safe here due to serial execution but should be documented.
findings.remediation: Add comment explaining why nonisolated(unsafe) is safe in this specific context.

findings.description: ChunkedSpeechBuffer.asContiguousArray() uses flatMap which is O(n). Consider lazy evaluation for large buffers.
findings.remediation: For very large buffers, consider returning a custom Sequence view instead of flattening eagerly.

findings.description: Multi-channel mixing uses scalar loop before vDSP. Could use vDSP_vgathr for better vectorization.
findings.remediation: For >2 channels, pre-extract all channels with vDSP then mix pairwise for full vectorization.

findings.description: resampleBuffer is preallocated but capacity not reserved. May cause reallocation during resampling.
findings.remediation: Reserve capacity based on expected maximum resample output size.

findings.description: Converter error logged but nil returned silently. Caller cannot distinguish resample failure from empty buffer.
findings.remediation: Consider propagating error information or logging at higher severity for debugging.

findings.description: extractSamples failure continues silently with 'continue'. Speech samples may be lost without notice.
findings.remediation: Add logging for extractSamples failures to aid debugging.

findings.description: withUnsafeBufferPointer guard let returns early silently. Could mask buffer issues.
findings.remediation: Add assertion or logging for nil baseAddress case during development.

findings.description: File is 1388 lines. Consider splitting into multiple files (Engine, Actors, Helpers).
findings.remediation: Extract FluidVadManager and SyncDouble to separate files in a Concurrency/Actors directory.

findings.description: File is 823 lines with multiple types. Buffer structs could be extracted.
findings.remediation: Move CircularAudioBuffer and ChunkedSpeechBuffer to Infrastructure/Audio/AudioBuffers.swift.

findings.description: Actor has mutable resampleBuffer but no cleanup method. Potential memory retention.
findings.remediation: Add cleanup() method to nil resampleBuffer when processor no longer needed.

verified: Zeroing deinit for crash dump protection
